verdict: The fixed-draw Alpha runtime now automatically routes every fixed-gate status callback through the accepted P3 feedback classifier, refreshes LATEST_ALPHA_FEEDBACK.txt without Owner commands, and fails closed on feedback-helper errors without losing P1 machine status.

tests.name: committed source compile and blob identity check
tests.detail: The exact production source compiled successfully; its locally computed Git blob SHA bf1edbda1adf1b4d60d1e648a5a97474b189c900 exactly matches the GitHub content SHA returned by implementation commit 5b5c61f9f0b91c48ba77031fbbb9637ef60d3575.

tests.name: bounded fixed-status to feedback refresh smoke
tests.detail: Using temporary local artifacts, ALPHA_FIXED_DRAW_STATUS.json with FIXED_TEST_ACTUALLY_DRAWN was consumed through the new refresh wiring and produced LATEST_ALPHA_FEEDBACK.txt with MACHINE_DRAW_PROOF_PRESENT_AWAITING_OWNER_VISUAL.

tests.name: feedback-helper execution failure fail-closed smoke
tests.detail: A simulated P3 RuntimeError left ALPHA_FIXED_DRAW_STATUS.json byte-for-byte unchanged and atomically replaced LATEST_ALPHA_FEEDBACK.txt with routingClassification=FEEDBACK_INPUT_MALFORMED, an exact OWNER_FEEDBACK_REFRESH_FAILED reason, and ownerVisualConfirmation=NOT_RECORDED.

tests.name: real WOF Owner visual acceptance
tests.detail: Authority explicitly forbids asking Owner to test in P4 and forbids moving alpha-live; live visual confirmation remains a PM-owned post-promotion boundary.

productProof.detail: Automatic runtime status-to-feedback wiring and fail-closed behavior are proven with bounded local artifacts. No real-WOF visual claim or Owner visual PASS is made.
